name.en: Fake free data giveaway from a network (“free data for old subscribers”)

how.en: A post or message says MTN or another network is giving free data, such as a month of free data for old SIM users or a big anniversary bundle. The link asks for your phone number and personal details, sometimes a payment, and often tells you to share it with many groups first. MTN says it never asks customers to submit details on outside websites to claim data or rewards.

text.en: A post says your network is giving free data to old subscribers or for an anniversary.
A link asks for your phone number and personal details to claim it.
You must share it with groups or pay a small fee before the data comes.
MTN 2026 ANNIVERSARY: all subscribers using their SIM for more than 6 months get 50GB free data for 30 days. Enter your number to claim yours here [link] and share with 5 groups to activate.

en: free data for old subscribers mtn link
claim free data enter your phone number
share to groups to activate free data
network giveaway asked me to pay to receive data
Free data offered through a link outside the network’s app or USSD code.
A request to share the link before you receive anything.
Check offers only in the MyMTN app, *180# or your network’s official app and pages.
Do not enter your number or personal details on outside sites, and do not forward the message.
Report fake promos to your network, and to the NCC on 622 if it is not resolved.
